## 简体中文

### 亮点

- 新增 sing-box 的 Linux 系统 DNS 接管，包括 `/etc/resolv.conf` 管理和系统 DNS 监听器校验。
- 新增主机侧网络测试页面，用于国内外连通性和公网 IP 诊断。
- 使用平台专属安装脚本改进发布包。

### 修复

- 探测运行期间保持网络测试行可见。
- 允许订阅来源列表为空。
- 支持显式本地 DNS 上游，并规范化 sing-box DNS detour。
- 接管 DNS 时锁定并恢复系统解析器状态，同时容忍不支持的解析器锁定操作。
- 清除过期的 TUN 启动错误并改进无头浏览器行为。
- 支持 sing-box 1.13 的 DNS 监听行为。

### 验证

- Release 工作流生成平台产物与校验和；本地验证覆盖 UI、DNS 接管、安装器和运行状态行为。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2)

## English

### Highlights

- Adds Linux system DNS takeover for sing-box, including `/etc/resolv.conf` management and system DNS listener validation.
- Adds host-side Network Test page for domestic/foreign reachability and public IP diagnostics.
- Improves release bundles with platform-specific installer scripts.

### Fixes

- Keeps Network Test rows visible while probes are running.
- Allows empty subscription source lists.
- Supports explicit local DNS upstreams and normalizes sing-box DNS detours.
- Locks and restores system resolver state during DNS takeover, while tolerating unsupported resolver lock operations.
- Clears stale TUN startup errors and improves headless browser behavior.
- Supports sing-box 1.13 DNS listener behavior.

### Verification

- Release workflow generated platform artifacts and checksums; local validation covered UI, DNS takeover, installer, and runtime state behavior.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2
